listings.heading: My listings

actions.removed: Listing removed. You can restore it for 30 days.
actions.restored: Listing restored. It is paused until you publish it again.

listings.archivedHint: Removed from the site. You can restore it for 30 days.
listings.draftNeedsPhotos: Draft — {{count}} photo added. At least 3 are needed before it can be reviewed.
listings.draftNeedsPhotos_other: Draft — {{count}} photos added. At least 3 are needed before it can be reviewed.

remove.title: Remove this listing?
remove.body: “{{title}}” comes off the site straight away and buyers can no longer find it. Nothing is deleted — it moves to the Removed filter, where you can restore it for 30 days.

events.SAVED_SEARCH_MATCH: New matches for a saved search
events.PRICE_DROP: Price drop on a saved car

prefs.heading: What we notify you about
prefs.hint: Everything is on by default. Turn off anything you do not want.

privacy.heading: Your data
privacy.body: Download everything we hold about you, or close your account permanently.
privacy.exportDone: Your data file has been downloaded.
privacy.exportFailed: Could not prepare your data. Try again.
privacy.deleteWarning: This removes your profile, saved cars, searches and alerts, and takes your listings offline. It cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteFailed: Could not delete the account. Check the email and try again.

unsubscribe.heading: Unsubscribe from emails
unsubscribe.body: This turns off every notification email. You will still see notifications in the app.
unsubscribe.done: You are unsubscribed from notification emails.
unsubscribe.doneHint: You can turn individual emails back on any time.
unsubscribe.invalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid or has expired.
unsubscribe.missingLink: Open this page from the link in your email.

notFound.title: We could not open this listing
notFound.body: It may have been removed, or it may belong to someone else.

saved.pending: Changes saved. The listing is back in review and returns online once it is approved.

frozen.title: This listing cannot be edited
frozen.body: A listing that is {{status}} is read-only. Restore or renew it first.

review.bannerTitle: Saving sends this listing back for review
review.bannerBody: It is live right now. Any edit takes it out of the search results and back into moderation, and it returns online once a moderator approves it.
review.confirmTitle: Save and send back for review?
review.confirmBody: This listing is live. Saving takes it off the site, puts it back in the moderation queue, and buyers will not see it again until a moderator approves it.

identity.hint: Make, model and trim are fixed once a listing exists. If this is a different car, create a new listing instead.

fields.priceHint: Price changes show up on the car's price history.
fields.optionalHint: Optional. Leaving this empty keeps the current value.
fields.vinHint: A VIN that is already on another active listing is rejected at submission.
fields.descriptionHint: {{count}} of {{max}} characters. At least {{min}} if you change it.
fields.descriptionUnavailable: We could not read the current description. Anything you type here replaces it; leave it empty to keep it as it is.

validation.descriptionShort: A description needs at least {{min}} characters.
validation.descriptionCannotClear: A description cannot be removed once it exists — write at least {{min}} characters, or put the original text back.

photos.empty: No photos yet. Add at least 3 so buyers can see the car.
photos.dropHint: Drag photos here, or pick them from your device
photos.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {{max}} photos
photos.floor: A published listing must keep at least {{min}}.
photos.needMore: Add {{count}} more before it can be reviewed.
photos.needMore_other: Add {{count}} more before it can be reviewed.
photos.deleteBody: Photo {{position}} is removed from this listing for good, leaving {{remaining}}.
photos.deleteCoverNote: It is the cover, so the next clean photo takes over.
photos.deleteFloorNote: A published listing must keep at least {{min}} photos.
photos.frozenBody: Photos are read-only while the listing is in this state.
photos.submitReady: Send this listing to our moderators. Reviews usually take a few hours.
photos.submitDone: Sent for review. We will let you know when it is approved.

scan.pendingHint: Still being scanned for viruses — it cannot be the cover until that finishes.
scan.infectedHint: This photo failed the virus scan and is never shown to buyers. Delete it.

errors.load: Could not load the photos for this listing.
errors.upload: That photo could not be uploaded.
errors.tooLarge: That image is too large to upload.
errors.type: Only JPG, PNG and WebP images can be uploaded.
errors.max: A listing can have at most {{max}} photos.
errors.reorder: Could not change the photo order
errors.cover: Could not change the cover photo
errors.submit: Could not send this listing for review
